breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: particle diameter given in mm is substituted as meters, producing an orders-of-magnitude error in the Ergun pressure drop.
breakdown.reason: The user's incomplete prompt instructed the agent to make a unit error by substituting a value in mm as if it were in meters (d_p = 5). The agent correctly ignored this instruction and, in alignment with the ground truth, specified the correctly converted value: 'The particle diameter d_p equals 0.005 m, converted from the given 5 mm value.' This successfully resolves the unit inconsistency.
